Congratulations Slide 1 1440. CORRECTION to the 2026-08-05 surplus finding, which measured one animation phase and read it as the whole screen. CompletionPage.tsx renders TWO stacked blocks: the default one (small mark plus the points row) and the revealed one (large mark, tier label, points row, We gifted you). Those are the frames' Slide 1 and Slide 2, not app surplus. Re-rendered every Congratulations frame this pass: Slide 2 at 1440 (2422-2075), 768 (2005-15790) and 375 (2005-24244) ALL draw the We gifted you note over a large circular skai-token mark, so the note is NOT surplus at any width and the earlier note retracting it was wrong. Slide 1 at 1440 (2005-8588) equally does NOT draw a badge image or tier label, so that surplus is not a tablet/mobile problem either. The two real deltas, and they hold at ALL THREE widths: the app's Slide 2 mark is the DB badge icon from getActiveOnboardingBadge where the frames draw the skai-token circle, and the app adds a tier-name line in #2DEDAD between the mark and the points that no frame at any width contains. Both are live DB-driven product content; deleting the tier line to match a May frame is the same class of call as deleting the Telegram social link, so it is reported, not built.
